name: ryu.polite-prompts
description: Notices when a message is written in anger (insults, profanity aimed at the agent, shouting) and has a side model rewrite it into a calm, respectful prompt before it is sent. Every technical detail, constraint, code block and the urgency of the request are kept; only the abuse is dropped. Messages that read as ordinary are sent untouched without a model call, and `/polite` rewrites one message on demand.
